segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy
one! Which is the first place where the Earth 
feels most happy?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'It is the place whereon
one of the faithful steps forward, O Spitama Zarathushtra!
with the log in his hand , the Baresma in
his hand, the milk in his hand, the mortar in his
hand, lifting up his voice in good accord with religion,
and beseeching Mithra , the lord of the rolling
country-side, and Rama Hvastra .'
2,3. O Maker of the material world, thou Holy one! Which is the
second place where the Earth feels most happy? Ahura Mazda answered:
'It is the place whereon one of the faithful erects a house with
a priest within, with cattle, with a wife, with children, and
good herds within; and wherein afterwards the cattle continue
to thrive, virtue to thrive, fodder to thrive, the dog to thrive,
the wife to thrive, the child to thrive, the fire to thrive, and
every blessing of life to thrive.'

O Maker of the material world, thou Holy one! Which is the
third place where the Earth feels most happy? Ahura Mazda answered:
'It is the place where one of the faithful sows most corn, grass,
and fruit, O Spitama Zarathushtra! where he waters ground that
is dry, or drains ground that is too wet.'
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！大地感到最歡悅的第三處在哪裡？阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉啊，那是忠信者播種最多穀物、草地和果實的地方！是他澆灌乾涸的地，或排乾過於潮濕的地的地方。」

fourth place where the Earth feels most happy? Ahura Mazda answered:
'It is the place where there is most increase of flocks and herds.'

fifth place where the Earth feels most happy? Ahura Mazda answered:
'It is the place where flocks and herds yield most dung.'

first place where the Earth feels sorest grief? Ahura Mazda answered:

segments.en:
Let no man alone by himself carry a corpse.
If a man alone by himself carry a corpse,
the Nasu rushes upon him, to defile
him, from the nose of the dead, from the eye, from the tongue,
from the jaws, from the sexual organs, from the hinder parts.
This Druj Nasu falls upon him, [stains him] even to the end of
the nails, and he is unclean, thenceforth, for ever and ever.
segments.zh:
任何人都不應該獨自一人運送屍體。
如果有人獨自一人運送屍體，
納蘇會從死者的鼻子、眼睛、舌頭、
顎部、性器官、後部撲向他，玷污
他。這德魯格‧納蘇落在他身上，〔玷污他〕直到指甲末端，他從此
永遠永遠不潔。

segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy one! What shall be
the place of that man who has carried a corpse [alone]? Ahura
Mazda answered: 'It shall be the place on this earth wherein is
least water and fewest plants, whereof the ground is the cleanest
and the dryest and the least passed through by flocks and herds,
by the fire of Ahura Mazda, by the consecrated bundles of Baresma,
and by the faithful.'
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！那位運載過屍體〔的人〕應當住在什麼地方？阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「那應當是此地球上水最少、植物最少之地，其地面最潔淨、最乾燥，且最少為牧群所經過之地，為阿胡拉‧馬茲達的火、為奉獻的聖枝束、為信徒所經過之地。」

Ahura Mazda answered: 'Thirty paces from the fire, thirty

18,19. 'There, on that place, shall the worshippers of Mazda erect
an enclosure, and therein shall they establish him with food,
therein shall they establish him with clothes, with the coarsest
food and with the most worn-out clothes. That food he shall live
on, those clothes he shall wear, and thus shall they let him live,
until he has grown to the age of a Hana, or of a Zaurura, or of
a Pairishta-khshudra.
20,21. 'And when he has grown to the age of a Hana, or of a Zaurura,
or of a Pairishta-khshudra, then the worshippers of Mazda shall
order a man strong, vigorous, and skilful, to cut the head
off his neck, in his enclosure on the top of the mountain: and
they shall deliver his corpse unto the greediest of the corpse-eating
creatures made by the beneficent Spirit, unto the vultures, with
these words: "The man here has repented of all his evil thoughts,
words, and deeds. If he has committed any other evil deed, it
is remitted by his repentance: if he has committed no other evil
deed, he is absolved by his repentance, for ever and ever."'
segments.zh:
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『離火三十步遠，離水三十步遠，離聖化的巴雷斯瑪束三十步遠，離信仰者三步遠。
『在那處，在那個地方，馬茲達的信仰者應當設立一個圍籬，並在其中以食物安頓他，在其中以衣物安頓他，以最粗劣的食物和最破舊的衣物安頓他。他應以那食物維生，他應穿著那衣物，他們應以此方式讓他活著，直到他成長到哈納，或查烏魯拉，或帕伊利什塔-克舒德拉的年紀。
『當他成長到哈納，或查烏魯拉，或帕伊利什塔-克舒德拉的年紀時，馬茲達的信仰者應當命令一個強壯、精力充沛、技藝高超的人，在山頂上的他的圍籬內，自他的頸部斬下他的首級：他們應將他的屍體交給仁慈的精靈所造最饑饉的食屍生物，交給禿鷹，說出這樣的言詞：『此處的人已悔改了他的一切邪惡思想、言論和行為。若他已犯下任何其他邪惡行為，他的悔改會免除它：若他未曾犯下任何其他邪惡行為，他因其悔改而得以赦免，永遠永遠。』』

'Unhappy is the land that has long lain unsown with the seed
of the sower and wants a good husbandman, like a well-shapen maiden
who has long gone childless and wants a good husband.
segments.zh: 「不幸的是那片長久以來未被撒種者之種子所播種、且缺少良好耕作者的土地，猶如一位姿容秀美的少女長久以來無子而缺少良好丈夫。」

26,27. 'He who would till the earth, O Spitama Zarathushtra! with
the left arm and the right, with the right arm and the left, unto
him thus says the Earth: "O thou man! who dost till me with
the left arm and the right, with the right arm and the left, here
shall I ever go on bearing, bringing
forth all manner of food, bringing corn first to thee."
28,29. 'He who does not till the earth, O Spitama Zarathushtra!
with the left arm and the right, with the right arm and the left,
unto him thus says the Earth: "O thou man! who dost not till
me with the left arm and the right, with the right arm and the
left, ever shalt thou stand at the door of the stranger, among
those who beg for bread; the refuse and the crumbs of the bread
are brought unto thee, brought by those who have profusion
of wealth."'
segments.zh:
那位用左臂和右臂、用右臂和左臂來耕耘大地的人啊，斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉！大地將為他帶來豐富的果實：正如同一位情人與他的新娘睡在她的床上；新娘將生育兒女，（大地將帶來）豐富的果實。
那位用左臂和右臂、用右臂和左臂來耕耘大地的人啊，斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉！大地如此對他說：「啊，你這個男人！你用左臂和右臂、用右臂和左臂來耕耘我，從此我將永遠繼續生育、帶來各種食物、首先為你帶來穀物。」
那位不用左臂和右臂、不用右臂和左臂來耕耘大地的人啊，斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉！大地如此對他說：「啊，你這個男人！你不用左臂和右臂、不用右臂和左臂來耕耘我，你將永遠站在陌生人的門前，在乞求麵包的人群中；麵包的殘渣和碎屑將被帶給你，由那些擁有豐富財富的人帶來。」

segments.orig:
ýô imãm zãm aiwi-verezyeiti spitama
zarathushtra hâvôya bâzvô dashinaca dashina
bâzvô haoyaca
âat aoxta îm zå, nara
ýô mãm aiwi-verezyeihi
hâvôya bâzvô dashinaca
dashina bâzvô haoyaca

bâdha idha âfrasâne danghubyô
bâdha idha aêni berethi
vîspå hvareñtîsh para-barãn
hãmberethwãm parô ýavahe.

ýô imãm zãm nôit aiwi-verezyeiti
spitama zarathushtra hâvôya bâzvô dashinaca
dashina bâzvô haoyaca
âat aoxta îm zå, nara
ýô mãm nôit aiwi-verezyeihi
hâvôya bâzvô dashinaca
dashina bâzvô haoyaca

bâdha idha hishtahe anyehe dvare srayanô hvareñtîsh
peresemnaêshuca,
bâdha thwãm tarasca ånghânô
srasciñtîsh hvarethå bairyeiñte tê
âbya bairyeiñte
ýaêshãm dim frâyô vohunãm.

dâtare gaêthanãm astvaitinãm ashâum
kat asti daênayå mâzdayasnôish uruthware,
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, ýat ukhrem paiti
ýaokarshti spitama zarathushtra.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou
Holy one! What is the food that fills the Religion
of Mazda? Ahura Mazda answered: 'It is sowing corn again
and again, O Spitama Zarathushtra!
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！什麼是填滿馬茲達宗教的食物？阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『那就是一次又一次地播種穀物，斯皮塔瑪查拉圖斯特拉啊！』

segments.orig:
ýô ýaom kârayeiti hô ashem
kârayeiti, hô daênãm mâzdayasnîm
fravâza vazaite, hô imãm daênãm
mâzdayasnîm frapinaoiti satem paitishtanãm
hazangrem paiti-daranãm baêvare paiti ýasnô-kereitinãm.
segments.en:
'He who sows corn, sows righteousness: he makes the Religion
of Mazda walk, he suckles the Religion of Mazda; as well as he
could do with a hundred man's feet, with a thousand woman's breasts,
with ten thousand sacrificial formulas.
segments.zh: 『誰播種穀物，誰就播種了正義：他讓馬茲達宗教行走，他養育馬茲達宗教；就如同他能用一百個人的腳步、一千個婦人的乳房、一萬個祭祀公式所能做到的那樣。』

segments.orig:
ýat ýavô dayât âat daêva
hvîsen ýat sudhush dayât âat daêva
tusen ýat pishtrô dayât âat daêva
uruthen ýat guñdô dayât âat daêva
peredhen, idha mithnât daêva aipi-jaiñti nmâne
ainghâi guñdayâi
zafare tafsãn aya masô
hãm-urvîsvånghô sadayeiti
ýat ýavô pourush bavât.
segments.en:
'When barley was created, the Daevas
started up; when it grew, then fainted the Daevas'
hearts; when the knots came, the Daevas groaned;
when the ear came, the Daevas flew away. In that
house the Daevas stay, wherein wheat perishes. It is
as though red hot iron were turned about in their throats, when
there is plenty of corn.
segments.zh: 『當大麥被創造時，迭瓦們跳躍起來；當它生長時，迭瓦們的心便消弱了；當穗出現時，迭瓦們呻吟了；當穀粒出現時，迭瓦們飛走了。在那座小麥滅亡的家中，迭瓦們停留。這就像赤熱的鐵在他們的喉嚨中轉動一樣，當穀物充足時。』

segments.orig:
adha mãthrem tadha mairyât,
naêcish ahvareñtãm tva nôit ukhrãm
ashayãm nôit ukhrãm vâstryãm
nôit ukhrãm puthrôishtîm, hvâshaya
zî vîspô anghush astvå jvaiñti
ahvâshe framiryeite!
segments.en:
'Then let people learn by heart this holy
saying [manthra -JHP]: "No one who does not eat, has strength to
do heavy works of holiness, strength to
do works of husbandry, strength to beget children.
By eating every material creature lives, by not eating it dies
away."'
segments.zh: 『那麼讓人們銘記於心這個聖言〔咒文〕：「不進食的人沒有力量做聖潔的重工作，沒有力量做農業的工作，沒有力量生育孩子。通過進食每一個物質生物活著，不進食則衰亡。」』

segments.orig:
dâtare gaêthanãm astvaitinãm ashâum
kô puxdhem imãm zãm mazishta xshnaoma xshnâvayeiti,
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, ýat bâ paiti
spitama zarathushtra ainghå zemô naire ashaone verezyât
ashaya dadhâiti.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy one! Who is the fifth
that rejoices the Earth with greatest joy?
Ahura Mazda answered: '[It is he who kindly and piously gives
to one of the faithful who tills the earth,] O Spitama Zarathushtra!
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！誰是第五位以最大的歡喜讓大地歡悅的人？阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『〔他就是那位友善而虔誠地給予一位耕種土地的信徒者，〕斯皮塔瑪查拉圖斯特拉啊！』

segments.orig:
ýat bâ paiti spitama zarathushtra ainghå
zemô naire ashaone verezyât ashaya vanghuya nôit
dadhâiti avi tem spayât speñtayå ârmatôish
temô âca vaêshô âca acishtem âca
ahûm â vîspaca avi tikhra nimata!
segments.en:
'He who would not kindly and piously
give to one of the faithful who tills the earth, O
Spitama Zarathushtra! Spenta Armaiti will
throw him down into darkness, down into the world of woe, the
world of hell, down into the deep abyss.'
segments.zh: 『他若不友善而虔誠地給予一位耕種土地的信徒，斯皮塔瑪查拉圖斯特拉啊！斯彭塔‧阿爾邁提將把他投入黑暗中，投入痛苦的世界、地獄的世界、深深的深淵中。』

segments.orig:
dâtare gaêthanãm astvaitinãm ashâum
ýat ainghå zemô nikañte spânasca
irista naraêca irista naêmem ýâre- drâjô
anuskañte kâ-hê asti citha, âat mraot
ahurô mazdå, pañca sata upâzananãm
upâzôit aspahe ashtraya pañca sata sraoshô-caranaya.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy one! If a man shall
bury in the earth either the corpse of a dog or the corpse of
a man, and if he shall not disinter it within half a year, what
is the penalty that he shall pay?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Five hundred stripes with the Aspahe-ashtra,
five hundred stripes with the Sraosho-charana.'
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！如果一個人把狗的屍體或人的屍體埋在地裡，並且在半年內沒有將其挖出，他必須支付什麼樣的懲罰？阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『五百次以馬鞭抽打，五百次以斯勞沙鞭抽打。』

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum ýat ainghå zemô
nikañte spânasca irista naraêca irista ýâre-drâjô
anuskañte kâ hê asti citha, âat mraot
ahurô mazdå, hazangrem upâzananãm upâzôit
aspahe ashtraya hazangrem sraoshô-caranaya.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy one! If a man shall
bury in the earth either the corpse of a dog or the corpse of
a man, and if he shall not disinter it within a year, what is
the penalty that he shall pay? 
Ahura Mazda answered: 'A thousand stripes with the Aspahe-ashtra,
a thousand stripes with the Sraosho-charana.'
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！如果一個人把狗的屍體或人的屍體埋在地裡，並且在一年內沒有將其挖出，他必須支付什麼樣的懲罰？阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『一千次以馬鞭抽打，一千次以斯勞沙鞭抽打。』

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum ýat ainghå zemô
nikañte spânasca irista naraêca irista byâre-drâjô
anuskañte kâ hê asti citha kâ-hê
asti âperetish kat hê asti ýaozhdâthrem.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy one! If a man shall
bury in the earth either the corpse of a dog or the corpse of
a man, and if he shall not disinter it within the second year,
what is the penalty for it? What is the atonement for it? What
is the cleansing from it?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若有人將狗的屍體或人的屍體埋在地中，且在第二年內不將之挖出，此事的懲罰為何？此事的補贖為何？此事的淨禮為何？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, nava-hê asti
citha nava-hê asti âperetish nôit hê asti
ýaozhdâthrem anâperetha haca shyaothna ýavaêca
ýavaêtâtaêca.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'For that deed there is nothing that
can pay, nothing that can atone, nothing that can cleanse from
it; it is a trespass for which there is no atonement, for ever
and ever.'
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「為此業行，無物可償，無物可補贖，無物可淨禮；此乃無可補贖之過犯，永遠永遠無法補贖。」

segments.orig:
kva aêva, ýezi anghat âstûtô
vâ aiwi-sravanô vâ daênãm mâzdayasnîm
âat ýezi anghat anâstûtô vâ
anaiwi-sravanô vâ daênãm mâzdayasnîm,
aêtâcit aêibyô spånghaite âstavanaêibyô
daênãm mâzdayasnîm everezenbyô
pascaêta arathwya shyaothna.
segments.en:
When is it so? 
'It is so, if the sinner be a professor of the
Religion of Mazda, or one who has been taught
in it.
'But if he be not a professor of the Religion of Mazda, nor one
who has been taught in it, then his sin is taken from him, if
he makes confession of the Religion of Mazda and resolves never
to commit again such forbidden deeds.
segments.zh: 何時會如此？「若罪人為馬茲達宗教的信奉者，或曾受其教導者，則會如此。但若罪人非馬茲達宗教的信奉者，亦未曾受其教導，則若其認信馬茲達宗教且決意永不再犯如此禁止之行為，其罪過即會被除去。」

segments.orig:
spayeite zî spitama zarathushtra daêna mâzdayasnish
narsh âstavanahe bañdem spayeite draoshem spayeite
ashavakhnîm spayeite nasuspaêm spayeite anâperethem
shyaothnem spayeite derezânô-peretem pârem spayeite
vîspa tâ shyaothna ýâ-cica verezyeiti.
segments.en:
'The Religion of Mazda indeed, O
Spitama Zarathushtra! takes away from him who
makes confession of it the bonds of his sin; it takes
away (the sin of) breach of trust; it takes away (the
sin of) murdering one of the faithful; it takes away
(the sin of) burying a corpse; it takes away (the
sin of) deeds for which there is no atonement; it
takes away the worst sin of usury; it takes away
any sin that may be sinned.
segments.zh: 「馬茲達宗教啊，斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉！凡認信其者，此宗教即除去其罪之束縛；即除去背信之罪；即除去謀害信徒之罪；即除去埋葬屍體之罪；即除去無可補贖之罪；即除去最大的高利貸之罪；即除去一切可被犯之罪。」

segments.orig:
mãnayen ahe spitama zarathushtra daêna mâzdayasnish
narsh ashaonô framerezaiti vîspem dushmatemca duzhûxtemca
duzhvarshtemca ýatha vâtô derezi-takathrô
thwâshem dashinât pairi framerezôit, [vohu idha
zarathushtra hvarshtem shyaothnem verezimnem vanguhi daêna
mâzdayasnish perenâyush cithãm thweresaiti]!
ashem vohû...!!
segments.en:
'In the same way the Religion of Mazda, O Spitama Zarathushtra!
cleanses the faithful from every evil thought, word, and deed,
as a swift-rushing mighty wind cleanses the plain.
'So let all the deeds he doeth be henceforth good, O Zarathushtra!
a full atonement for his sin is effected by means of the Religion
of Mazda.'
segments.zh: 「同樣地，馬茲達宗教啊，斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉！此宗教使信徒清潔於一切邪惡之思、言、行，如迅疾奔騰之強風清潔原野。所以，查拉圖斯特拉啊，自此以後願其所行之事皆為善事！其罪之完全補贖乃藉由馬茲達宗教而成就。」
